upload.title: Upload your bank statement (CSV)
upload.body: Export your transactions as a CSV file from your bank's app or website, then choose it here. Up to 1,000 rows and 2 MB.
upload.howTo: Most banks offer "Export" or "Download statement" as CSV.

errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than 2 MB. Export a shorter date range and try again.
errors.empty: We couldn't find any rows with column headings in that file.
errors.tooManyRows: That file has more than {{max}} rows. Export a shorter date range and try again.
errors.noValidRows: None of the rows could be read with these settings. Check the columns and date format.

map.title: Match your file's columns
map.body_one: {{file}}: {{count}} row found. We've guessed the columns; check they look right.
map.body_other: {{file}}: {{count}} rows found. We've guessed the columns; check they look right.
map.dateRange: Your file covers {{from}} to {{to}}. If that looks wrong, change the date format.
map.noDates: No dates could be read with this format.
map.splitHint: Debit and credit are in different columns.

review.title: Review before importing
review.autoCategorized_one: MoneyFlow Pro sorted {{count}} transaction into a category for you. Check it below.
review.autoCategorized_other: MoneyFlow Pro sorted {{count}} transactions into categories for you. Check them below.
review.proHint: MoneyFlow Pro sorts imported transactions into categories automatically and learns from your corrections.

done.skipped_one: {{count}} was skipped because you already had it.
done.skipped_other: {{count}} were skipped because you already had them.

privacy: Your file is read in your browser. Only the transactions you choose to import are sent to MoneyFlow.
